notes: Final cycle. One open minor defect (D9, texture) deliberately deferred.

defects.text: 6,024 tris, 0.4% over the 6,000 target and 40% under the 10,000 maximum. Justified: the extra triangles are the sight, bolt and stock disc detail; no further trim worth the silhouette risk.
Blued parts carry long white hair-like scratches and chip blotches from the shared gun texture; real blued steel wears at edges. Not fixable in geometry.
defects.fix: Needs a purpose-made blued/phosphated steel texture (separate texture task).

defects.text: Stock disc round again; butt plate covers the heel and matches the stock end.
